comment: Published benchmark results of base model families for the local model library (Settings > AI > Local models; docs/ai.md). Every score is copied from the page in its family's 'source' (or the score's own 'source'), as the publisher reported it; 'mode' says which column when a table has several. Scores apply to a repository that is the family's model or a quantization of it, never to fine-tunes or merges. The composite used for sorting is the mean of the 'core' metrics a family reports.

families.note: The Hugging Face card has no table; it links the Qwen3 blog and cites the Qwen3 Technical Report (arXiv 2505.09388). Scores are from report Tables 17 (thinking) and 18 (non-thinking), column 'Qwen3-8B'. Thinking is the default mode. Publisher self-reported.
